sources_considered.why: Controlled benchmark with continuing generalization failures and some training-driven improvements.
Demonstrates that some difficult generalization failures can be improved.
Evidence available in 2026 of mechanisms supporting abstract generalization; not a data-only decisive event.

evidence_items.explanation: OMEGA finds continuing failures on controlled mathematical generalization tests. Failures in tested models do not establish that every future amount of training data will be insufficient.
The study provides counterweight to a blanket inability-to-generalize interpretation. Its task-specific improvements do not establish broad reliability from data scaling alone.

The study examines transferable representations in obfuscated tasks and reports causal interventions affecting accuracy. Extended thinking and representation interventions do not isolate increased training data as the cause.

unresolved_gaps: No cited result proves permanent insufficiency across the claim's broad scope.
No cited demonstration establishes broad reliability through increased data alone.
A finite collection of failures cannot settle never, and narrow successes cannot settle enough.
